# Finish Line (Whiplash)

Finish Line is the gray Earth pony filly wearing helmet No. 1 in the roller derby scene in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Her racing nickname is **Whiplash**, as established by her licensed trading card, not by television dialogue. She is the jammer (scoring skater) alongside Bolt and Hairpin Turn.

[![Hasbro / DHX Media — Call of the Cutie, Finish Line at right](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/17/1070712__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_bolt%2B%28character%29_finish%2Bline%2B%28character%29_hairpin%2Bturn_earth%2Bpony_pony_call%2Bof%2Bthe%2Bcutie_female_filly_.png)](https://twibooru.org/1070712)

- **Appearance:** Gray coat, dark charcoal mane, black-and-white tail, dark eyes, checkered-flag cutie mark, red-and-black checkered helmet and red-wheeled skates.
- **Naming:** Unnamed in the episode; concept art reportedly groups her under Tough Ponies. Enterplay's Premiere card #9, [Finish Line, Jammer](https://www.heartofthecards.com/code/mlpcardlist.html?cardnum=9), gives both her name and derby nickname. The latter is distinct from the unrelated pegasus also called Whiplash.
- **Speaking status:** No individual spoken dialogue or verified voice credit; the skaters growl collectively in the [episode transcript](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=51811). Her card's first-person flavor text is not a spoken television line.
- **Appearances:** Her only verified television appearance is *Call of the Cutie* (S1E12). The [roller derby character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Roller_derby_ponies) also records her on page 32 of IDW's *When Cutie Calls*, a comic adaptation of the episode. In Gameloft's mobile game she is called [Tough Roller Derby Pony](https://all-the-ponies.com/en/pony/Pony_Tough_Roller_Derby_Pony/), a Ponyville resident introduced in update 11.1. These are licensed depictions, not additional television appearances.

## Important moments

Both beats occur in the same brief sequence of [Call of the Cutie (S1E12), official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=69q78WoBGUs); exact video timestamps unavailable.

- **The intimidating derby team** — *Call of the Cutie* (S1E12). Finish Line and her teammates race after Apple Bloom during Rainbow Dash's crash course in discovering a special talent.
- **The pileup** — *Call of the Cutie* (S1E12). Apple Bloom trips and all three skaters tumble into her, ending another unsuccessful attempt to earn her cutie mark.

No further defining scenes or separately attributed fan artwork were verified. The wiki was available through indexed excerpts, but direct page retrieval was blocked.
